```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
options(error = rlang::entrace, rlang_backtrace_on_error = "full")
library(tidyverse)
plants <- read.csv("tabular_data/Saanich_Tracheophyta_ultimate-catalogue_2026-08-17-selected-labels.csv")
plant.summary <- read.csv("tabular_data/Saanich_Tracheophyta_ultimate-summary_2026-08-20-prepared-taxa.csv", fileEncoding = "UTF-8") %>%
  filter(inSummary == 1)
new <- plant.summary %>% filter(str_detect(reportingStatus, "new"))
confirmed <- plant.summary %>% filter(reportingStatus == 'confirmed')
reported <- plant.summary %>% filter(reportingStatus == 'unconfirmed')
# Species with at least one iNaturalist observation, whose records are identified by their occurrenceID
inat.taxa <- unique(plants$iNaturalistTaxonId[grepl("inaturalist.org/observations", plants$occurrenceID)])
inat.percent <- round(mean(plant.summary$id %in% inat.taxa) * 100)
# observed <- plant.summary %>% filter(iNatObservationStatus == 'observed')
```

## Community contributions to our knowledge of the regional plant diversity

Through the combined efforts of `r length(unique(plants$recordedBy))` individuals, the Saanich naturalist
community has now documented a total of `r nrow(plant.summary)` vascular plant species. Since 2000, `r round((nrow(confirmed)/(nrow(confirmed)+nrow(reported))*100), digits = 0)` percent
of the historically reported plant diversity has been confirmed and `r nrow(new)` new species reports added to the
list.

<span class="saanich-callout">Community members have now documented `r inat.percent` percent of the total plant diversity known to the region on iNaturalist.</span>

Contribute to this growing record by submitting your observations to the [“Lost” plants of the Saanich Peninsula iNaturalist project](https://www.inaturalist.org/projects/lost-plants-of-the-saanich-peninsula)!
